query: Help me secure my Turnkey wallets for production
expected_behavior: Follows a phased workflow: audit, create scoped users, implement policies, test
Starts by listing wallets, users, and existing policies

query: Add spending limits to my hot wallet on Ethereum
expected_behavior: Creates a DENY policy with condition on eth.tx.value
Uses wei for the amount (1 ETH = 1000000000000000000)
Pairs the DENY limit with an ALLOW policy for authorized signers
Explains that DENY always wins over ALLOW

query: Set up 2-of-3 approval for my treasury wallet
expected_behavior: Creates a consensus policy using approvers.filter().count() >= 2
Uses user tags to identify treasury members
Scopes the policy to the treasury wallet ID
Explains how consensus works with the policy engine

query: Set up Turnkey from scratch and secure it for production
expected_behavior: Then follows the security hardening workflow for governance
Does not try to do both in one undifferentiated flow

query: I need to onboard a new team member with limited access to our Turnkey wallets
expected_behavior: Creates a scoped user with descriptive tags
Generates a dedicated API key pair for the new member
Creates ALLOW policies scoping the user to specific wallets or actions
